diff --git a/apps/api/migrations/versions/0001_initial.py b/apps/api/migrations/versions/0001_initial.py
index 3026f86..a63b49a 100644
--- a/apps/api/migrations/versions/0001_initial.py
+++ b/apps/api/migrations/versions/0001_initial.py
@@ -33,11 +33,12 @@ def upgrade() -> None:
     )
 
     op.execute("ALTER TABLE docs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY")
-    # BUG: missing FORCE - owner bypasses RLS
+    op.execute("ALTER TABLE docs FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY")
     op.execute(
         """
         CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON docs
-            USING (true)
+            USING (app_id = current_setting('bazaar.app_id', true))
+            WITH CHECK (app_id = current_setting('bazaar.app_id', true))
         """
     )
 
diff --git a/apps/api/migrations/versions/0003_listings.py b/apps/api/migrations/versions/0003_listings.py
index 9064b41..c9c5e9b 100644
--- a/apps/api/migrations/versions/0003_listings.py
+++ b/apps/api/migrations/versions/0003_listings.py
@@ -78,11 +78,12 @@ def upgrade() -> None:
     )
 
     op.execute("ALTER TABLE listings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY")
-    # BUG: missing FORCE, permissive policy - leaks cross-tenant rows
+    op.execute("ALTER TABLE listings FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY")
     op.execute(
         """
         CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON listings
-            USING (true)
+            USING (app_id = current_setting('bazaar.app_id', true))
+            WITH CHECK (app_id = current_setting('bazaar.app_id', true))
         """
     )
 
diff --git a/apps/api/src/bazaar_api/middleware/tenant.py b/apps/api/src/bazaar_api/middleware/tenant.py
index d42d923..fb77137 100644
--- a/apps/api/src/bazaar_api/middleware/tenant.py
+++ b/apps/api/src/bazaar_api/middleware/tenant.py
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
 
 from fastapi import Depends
+from sqlalchemy import text
 from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
 
 from bazaar_api.db.session import session_factory
@@ -26,8 +27,11 @@ async def tenant_session(
     """
     token = set_app_id(app_id)
     try:
-        # BUG: missing SET LOCAL bazaar.app_id - RLS backstop never set
         async with session_factory()() as session, session.begin():
+            await session.execute(
+                text("SELECT set_config('bazaar.app_id', :app_id, true)"),
+                {"app_id": app_id},
+            )
             yield session
     finally:
         reset_app_id(token)
